aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed SELECT TYPE and EXIT statement source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_117.json. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 255 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. authored_facets remains 1788, the fixture review states remain 1770 reference-validated, 274 source-reviewed and 1 needs-oracle, and the tests directory is untouched. Eighteen of the 35 scoped base units are newly accounted, because 17 numbered items were already counted, with the asymmetry of 13 in 11.1.11.1, none in 11.1.11.2 or 11.1.11.3 and four in 11.1.12 independently confirmed. 89 new facets remain pending. Before registering any numbered rule the author checked whether tests already held cases for it, because registering a numbered rule that already has legacy fixtures structurally forces binding them and a source packet must never do that; none of R1154 through R1158 or C1162 through C1173 had pre-existing cases, so registration was safe and nothing needed deferring, and the reviewer confirmed that check independently. The type-guard matching rules were derived from the source and verified word for word: a TYPE IS guard matches when the dynamic type and kind type parameter values are the same as specified, a CLASS IS guard matches when the dynamic type is an extension of the specified type, and selection prefers a matching TYPE IS, then a unique matching CLASS IS, then among several matching CLASS IS guards the one specifying a type that is an extension of all the types specified in the others, then CLASS DEFAULT, then no block. There is no processor latitude anywhere in this scope and none was invented; the single permission is the 11.1.11.2 p9 internal branch, whose only wording supplies the paired restriction. Two subtle readings were confirmed correct: C1168 does not prohibit one TYPE IS guard together with one CLASS IS guard specifying the same type, and C1172 is not a blanket ban on a textual EXIT inside a DO CONCURRENT construct but turns on which construct the EXIT belongs to. The boundary against 11.1.3.3 was checked in both directions, and no plan uses SAME_TYPE_AS or EXTENDS_TYPE_OF as an oracle basis since that would duplicate the feature under test. 11.1.11.3 yields zero facets because it is examples. No SELECT TYPE or EXIT execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
